scripts.demo: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-so-cong-dau --only firestore,auth,hosting
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-so-cong-dau --only firestore,auth "vitest run tests/setup.test.js tests/rules.test.js --passWithNoTests"
scripts.test:unit: firebase emulators:exec --project demo-so-cong-dau --only firestore,auth "vitest run --exclude tests/setup.test.js --exclude tests/rules.test.js --exclude tests/e2e/** --passWithNoTests"
